import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Convert text-formatted numbers to numeric
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Fix species label variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island whitespace variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Fix sex label variant and keep missing as NaN
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'female': 'female'})
    df.loc[df['sex'].isin(['nan', 'none', '']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (obvious extra-zero typo)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Average body mass per species; drop missing group keys implicitly
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    result = {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in result.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    return result
